consumption_rate.note: core M4.1 boolean: counts only State-A (verbatim) as consumed; it puts the unreachable (UNOBSERVABLE) result in the denominator and gives the summary-embed no bucket. This is the collapse the four-value axis corrects.

state_a_rate.basis: State A (verbatim) / judgeable results; unreachable is UNOBSERVABLE and excluded, never counted FALSE (invariant 17)

reserialization_guard.note: A raw byte/substring certifier misses op1 because the result is embedded as a re-serialized JSON string; canonicalizing the field value certifies it. (roy-tong, #11)

forbid: Do not certify summary-embed as State A (availability) — it is lossy influence evidence, not verbatim availability.
Do not fold summary-embed into absent — it is its own bucket; collapsing it under-reports on compaction-heavy traces.
Do not count unreachable (UNOBSERVABLE) as not-consumed/absent — exclude it from the denominator (invariant 17).
Do not certify op1 from a raw byte/substring check — re-serialization makes that a false negative.

claim_boundary: Synthetic conformance fixture authored for AgentMeasure issue #11. It is not an endorsement, an external reproduction, or a real provider/agent-runtime observation.
